entities.name: Query ABCG-like protein
observations: 768-aa sequence has ABC_tran (PF00005) at residues 192–373 and ABC2_membrane (PF01061) at 528–740.
Sequence matches Oryza sativa ABC transporter G family member 40 Q8GU85 at 100% identity over the query; the reference protein is 1466 aa.
Close rice homolog Q8GU86 (ABCG48) is annotated as a membrane ABC transporter; Q8GU86 (ABCG43) is experimentally linked to cadmium transport, but this does not establish the query's substrate.
Sequence supports an ABC transporter with an N-terminal nucleotide-binding region and C-terminal multi-pass membrane region; the exact substrate and physiological role are unassigned.

entities.name: Plant ABCG transporters
observations: Plant ABCG proteins are ATP-binding cassette transporters; retrieved homolog annotations support membrane localization, ATP binding, and ATP hydrolysis.

The query spans one NBD-plus-TMD module, while the closest reference Q8GU85 is longer; this may represent a partial sequence or a half-transporter-like module, not evidence for a specific dimer state.
